classification: Conditional persisted/public fixed-point fraction admission contract and panic-on-invalid read; inspected initialization and consumption preserve bounds.
trace: ConsumableFractionMicros has a private u32 and try_new rejects values greater than 1,000,000; zero and one whole are explicitly valid. Both public personal and party amount table records store the remaining fraction as raw u32. A representable row value of 1,000,001 is therefore outside the type contract; the inspected server persisted_fraction and two web presentation paths use expect after try_new, so such an invalid row would fail at those read sites. The public table declaration is not evidence that an external client may write it.

The inspected initialization writes WHOLE and both consumption paths take typed fractions, clamp the consumed amount to available, subtract with checked_sub, and write the resulting typed value or delete an empty row. Personal/party transfer copies a stored raw value, so its correctness depends on the existing row invariant. No normal invalid-state producer, corrupted row, browser failure or reducer execution has been established.

whole_divided_by asserts a nonzero divisor and rounds down in integer millionths; the inspected soap producer uses a positive capacity of 25. Do not equate the number of soap cleansing points, a fraction in millionths, inventory count and mass. All other writers, integrity assumptions, overflow semantics, projections and the linked inventory-lookup record remain open.
repair_direction: Trace every personal and party amount constructor, transfer, persistence admission and presentation. Decide the ownership and failure contract for invalid stored fractions, preserving valid zero/whole semantics, intentional fraction rounding and transactional transfers; follow generated binding rules if a future authorized schema change is chosen, without compatibility or migration paths.
later_acceptance: After separate repair authorization, cover zero, one, one-million, above-one-million, valid partial consumption, cross-owner transfer, soap points and web projections.
remaining: Prove whether invalid state is reachable and reconcile all connected inventory and historical entries. No product build, test, browser, database call or runtime probe was performed.
discovery_status: partial; representable invalid stored values and read-side panic sites, normal reachability unproved
